message:
Billable custom timeseries have climbed above the estate's normal range. Almost always this is one metric that gained an unbounded tag — a request id, a timestamp, a user id.

Baseline when this was set (RC1-451): 27 average and **81 max** over 30 days. The lab that produced these thresholds pushed one metric to 501 series with a single `probe_id` tag, which at this account's effective rate of $0.0181 per timeseries-month is $9.08/month — about a third of the entire Datadog bill.

**This monitor cannot name the metric.** `datadog.estimated_usage.metrics.custom.by_metric` reports `N/A` on this account, so grouping by metric buys nothing. To find the culprit, sort Metrics Summary by cardinality, then fix it with a tag configuration (`POST /api/v2/metrics/<metric>/tags`) rather than by deleting the metric — Metrics without Limits keeps the totals exact and drops only the breakdown you could not afford.

RC1-451. @webhook-incident-summarizer
